summary: Important: golang security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
The golang packages provide the Go programming language compiler.

Security Fix(es):

* net/http: golang: golang: Denial of Service via crafted HTTP Range headers (CVE-2026-78667)

* crypto/tls: golang: crypto/tls: Denial of Service via multiple ECH outer extension references (CVE-2026-97031)

* net/http: net/http/internal/http2: golang.org/x/net/http2: net/http: Denial of Service via excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames (CVE-2026-78669)

* golang: crypto/x509: Go: crypto/x509: mitigation for security concerns with a specific Certificate Authority (CVE-2026-111943)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Update Go to version 1.26.10+1 [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-287191)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
